name: Lisbeth Zwerger
description: Lisbeth Zwerger (born 1954) Lisbeth Zwerger is an award-winning Austrian illustrator renowned for her delicate, ethereal reinterpretations of classic children’s literature. Based in Vienna, she is widely considered one of the most influential contemporary artists in the genre. Signature Style: Masterful use of watercolors , muted palettes, and expansive negative space. Her work is characterized by a dreamlike, slightly melancholic atmosphere and elegant, whimsical figures. Key Works: Illustrated iconic editions of The Nutcracker , Alice in Wonderland , The Wizard of Oz , and the fairy tales of the Brothers Grimm and Hans Christian Andersen. Major Honor: Awarded the Hans Christian Andersen Medal in 1990, the highest international recognition for children’s book illustration. NOTE : Base model : Z Image Turbo.
